query:
SELECT ei.id, ei.name, ec.slug as catSlug, ec.name as catName
FROM equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL
ORDER BY ec.slug, ei.name
LIMIT 100;
